title: HUD Launches DataVendor Marketplace for Private AI Training Data
summary:
The exchange facilitates the licensing of domain-specific proprietary datasets by individuals and companies to artificial intelligence laboratories through a newly released public beta of HUD's DataVendor platform. Available listings for purchase include raw company records, reinforcement learning environments with their respective tasksets, and private codebases containing pull requests and full Git histories.

HUD spent 2 years building the infrastructure to address the shortage of high-quality data, which the company identifies as the primary bottleneck for AI progress. The marketplace targets researchers and firms seeking to monetize private data as it becomes a critical asset for the development of frontier AI models.
